'''Actinium Bombs''' were a type of explosives used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] Investigation teams suspect that these were the type of bombs used in the [[Caamas Firestorm|destruction]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]].<ref name="sos" />
